description: Create a record of the given sobject type with the given fields. Requires sobject and a non-empty fields object. This is a write action. Returns immediately with a job_id and status 'queued' (D0.3 deferred-completion shape) -- the dispatch returning is NOT the same as the record being created; the new id is delivered when the job completes.
embedding_description: Create a new Salesforce record (e.g. a new Contact, Opportunity, or custom object row) with the supplied field values. Requires sobject (the object API name) and a non-empty fields object. A write action, dispatched asynchronously: the job_id returns at once, the new record's id follows in a later message.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dispatch envelope: job_id (string) and status ('queued'). This is NOT the created record -- its id and success flag arrive separately, as their own message, when the job completes.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: This call only confirms the create was queued -- do not present job_id/status as confirmation the record exists. Acknowledge the request is in flight; the new record's id lands in a follow-up message when the job completes. Once delivered, confirm creation and report the new id; low sensitivity (id only, data_sensitivity 0.0).

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: sf.invalid_params: missing sobject or an empty/missing fields object. sf.malformed_query: a field value or combination was rejected (e.g. a required field missing, an invalid picklist value). sf.permission_denied: the CLI's authenticated user cannot create this object.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: sf.malformed_query: check required fields and valid values via describe_sobject. sf.permission_denied: ask the operator to check create permission for this object.
